title: Identity & Domains
subtitle: Affection and memory are isolated by (memory domain, person, preset). This page owns the first two: which instances share, and which two accounts are the same person.
readOnlyHint: You are a read-only member: none of the write actions on this page are open to you, so their buttons are not rendered (the server would reject them anyway).
needScope: Pick an instance scope first — merging and orphan cleanup both operate on a domain.

domain.intro: By default every instance is its own domain — with nothing configured the behaviour is byte-for-byte today's. Put several instances in one domain to let their memory and affection flow between them. The affection domain follows the memory domain; it is not configured separately.
domain.listHint: The name is display only and need not be unique; a group's identity is its ID
domain.empty: No domain configured yet — every instance is its own domain (fully isolated).
domain.bindHint: Each instance belongs to exactly one domain; "own domain" means unconfigured (no row is stored)
domain.createHint: A domain's ownership cannot be changed after creation, and only instances with matching ownership can join — that is the first gate against pulling another tenant's instance into your domain. Under a tenant identity the ownership is always your own tenant.
domain.ownerHint: Only instances with matching ownership can join. To set up a domain for a customer you must pick their tenant here, otherwise the group you create cannot hold a single one of their instances.
domain.joinedMigrated: {{instance}} joined "{{domain}}": {{rows}} affection row(s) moved ({{folded}} folded), {{aliases}} merge(s) carried over
domain.joinMemoryLine: After joining, this instance's previous {{paragraphs}} memories are immediately visible to other instances in the group (cross-channel recall is still bounded by the three switches); {{summaries}} channel summaries are only injected in their own channels and are not affected.
domain.joinMemoryQuarantined: {{count}} more are in quarantine and will not be recalled until restored.
domain.migrateLabel: Bring over this instance's own-domain affection, event log and account merges
domain.deleteWarning: Deleting domain "{{name}}" returns its {{count}} instance(s) to their own domains (no longer shared). Existing affection and memory are NOT deleted, but they live on the group domain — you would have to put the same instances back into one group to see them again.

requests.title: Pending self-reported requests
requests.hint: Users file "that account is also me" via the merge_request bot command; approving merges it (same path as a manual merge), rejecting only leaves a record
requests.approveLine: Approving merges {{alias}} into reporter {{reporter}} (affection compensated by "take the higher", the merge can be undone later).
requests.rejectLine: Reject {{reporter}}'s request to merge in {{alias}}: no data is merged, only the record is kept.
requests.reviewNoteLabel: Review note (sent back to the reporter on rejection)

merge.intro: A merge writes a single alias row and touches no data row: the secondary account keeps its own affection and event log, and undoing restores the state before the merge. The merge applies to the domain of the current instance{{domain}}.
merge.formHint: Preview first (what each side has, which value will be adopted), then execute
merge.transferTitle: Which value wins (per preset, the higher of the two)
merge.aliasesHint: Deleting a row undoes it: the secondary account returns to its own data
merge.aliasesEmpty: No account merge in this domain yet.
merge.revokeWarning: After undoing, {{alias}} returns to its own affection and event log (they were never modified), and the points granted to {{person}} under "take the higher one" are deducted again. Points earned during the merge stay with {{person}}.
merge.revoked: Undone: {{alias}} returned to its own data ({{delta}} points deducted)

orphan.empty: No orphaned data: every affection row hangs off a preset that still exists.
orphan.cleanupWarning: This permanently deletes {{rows}} affection row(s) covering {{people}} people and {{events}} event(s) under preset #{{preset}}. It cannot be undone; if that preset was deleted by mistake, recreate it first.

presetSwitch.title: Confirm preset change
presetSwitch.line: The preset of {{scope}} will change from "{{from}}" to "{{to}}".
presetSwitch.impact: This affects the affection and memory of {{people}} people. After the switch they will look like strangers here.
presetSwitch.impactChannels: This affects the affection and memory of {{people}} people across {{channels}} channels. After the switch they will look like strangers here.
presetSwitch.returning: The target preset "{{to}}" already has records for {{people}} people — that set comes back after the switch.
